'''Evram Darkmere''' was a space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who became an informer for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Darkmere's mother was a pirate, but when he was ten years old, she was killed during a conflict between the [[Daupherm Planet States]] and the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]], leaving Darkmere to raise himself and his younger brother, [[Garreck Darkmere]]. Two years later, Darkmere became a cabin boy in the [[Daupherm Merchant Space Fleet|Daupherm Merchant Fleet]] and his brother was sent to an orphanage. After rising through the ranks, Darkmere became a second-in-command, but was then drafted into the [[Daupherm Marine Corps]].

After his five-year tour with the military ended, Darkmere's former [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Gorvan Shrulldike]] stole the [[Retribution (Discril-class)|''Retribution'']], a [[Daupherm Systems Fleet]] [[Discril-class attack cruiser|''Discril''-class attack cruiser]], and set himself up as a slaver and space pirate. Darkmere joined Shrulldike's crew, but he found slavery to be repugnant so, with the backing of some Rebel agents, he defeated Shrulldike in single combat and became the new captain of the ''Retribution''. Darkmere met [[Arsitta Kushoe]], a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was serving as an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the Rebel Alliance, and they became very close. However, after she went missing-in-action, Darkmere became a reformed character and tried to aide the Alliance, although he continued to remain an independent operator. He would pass information to the Alliance via his best friend [[Nelson Flin]], who was an Alliance military operative. His [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] was [[Dexter Thorgrim]], and together they would often search [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], looking for new crew members. Darkmere once met with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] of the Alliance in a bar on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they shared a few [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]].
